about_the_game:
HARNESS THE POWER OF EVOLITS WITH FRIENDS

Evolits is a creature-collecting open-world MMORPG featuring turn-based PvE and PvP combat. Dive into the world of Evolia, assemble a mighty team of Evolits, and engage in strategic combat against mystical beasts in the wild and other players.

UNDERTAKE A PLETHORA OF TEAM AND SOLO ACTIVITIES

Hop into casual battle with wild evolits, challenge the celestial threats of Evolia in winding dungeons, or fight for glory against other players in the Arena. Not interested in combat? Partake in story-driven quests, enjoy lucrative trade with other players, or gather resources for valuable potions. There's always something to do in Evolia.

BRING TOGETHER YOUR TEAM

Build a collection of Evolits that suit your playstyle. Customize them with abilities, training, fusion, and runes. Develop mastery by creating interesting builds with the many complex interactions of the game.

EXPLORE THE WORLD OF EVOLIA

The vast world of Evolia is yours to discover. Unearth the mysterious lore of the universe, collect items of incredible potency, and be immersed into the fantastical world.

This game has cross-platform play with mobile.
